policy: Only project-specific dated published official operator/PLN/issuer observations. A COD evidence date documents a historical event; it is not a live 2026 online availability guarantee. Do not equate MWp photovoltaic DC rating to MW nameplate grid/AC rating without technical definition. For Jawa-9/10, project-complex COD is not assigned to a separately mapped generating unit unless explicit unit-to-project correspondence is sourced.

observations.capacity_scope: separate source-listed 1,000 MW unit; plant complex totals 2,000 MW
observations.source_validity: Project operator describes whole combined plant COD; do not infer unit-to-Jawa-9 COD chronology.

observations.capacity_scope: separate source-listed 1,000 MW unit; plant complex totals 2,000 MW
observations.source_validity: Project operator describes whole combined plant COD; do not infer unit-to-Jawa-10 COD chronology.
